column1: # ARM DDI 0487 C4.1.95.14 Advanced SIMD modified immediate: (word & 0x9ff80400) == 0x0f000400.
# Enumerates all 2 x 2 x 16 x 2 = 128 combinations of Q=0..1, op=0..1, cmode=0..15, o2=0..1:
# imm8 in {0x00, 0x01, 0x80, 0xff} for cmode=0..14 with Rd=1 (480 rows), all 256 imm8=0..255 values
# for cmode=0b1111 FMOV/unallocated space with Rd=1 (2,048 rows), plus Rd=31 across cmode=0..15
# with imm8 in {0x00, 0x01, 0x80, 0xff} (512 rows), totaling 3,040 rows.
# Reference tool version: Apple LLVM version 21.0.0
# Assembly command: xcrun clang -arch arm64e advsimd_modified_imm.s -o advsimd_modified_imm.macho
# Generation command: python3 -I Scripts/acceptance/encoding-table.py generate advsimd_modified_imm
